title: Launch of the EPNU TechX 2026 Competition at East Portsaid National University
text:
في إطار حرص جامعة شرق بورسعيد على دعم التحول الرقمي وتعزيز المهارات التطبيقية لدى الطلاب، أعلن مركز نظم المعلومات بالجامعة عن إطلاق المسابقة التكنولوجية السنوية
EPNU TechX 2026
، وذلك تحت رعاية الأستاذ الدكتور/ عاطف علم الدين رئيس الجامعة.
وتهدف المسابقة إلى إشراك طلاب الجامعة في تطوير صفحات البرامج الأكاديمية على الموقع الإلكتروني الرسمي، من خلال تصميم وتنفيذ قالب موحد (Template) باستخدام نظام إدارة المحتوى
WordPress
، بما يسهم في تحسين تجربة المستخدم، وتقديم المحتوى الأكاديمي بصورة أكثر تنظيمًا وجاذبية، إلى جانب دعم توجه الجامعة نحو التحول الرقمي وتحديث بنيتها التكنولوجية.
وتتيح المسابقة الفرصة لطلاب الجامعة للمشاركة في فرق عمل مكونة من 2 إلى 4 طلاب، حيث يتعاون أعضاء الفريق على تطوير نموذج متكامل لصفحات البرامج الأكاديمية، مع الالتزام بالمحتوى الرسمي المعتمد، والعمل على تحسين التصميم وتجربة المستخدم وسهولة التصفح، خاصة على الأجهزة المحمولة. وتستمر فعاليات المسابقة لمدة ثلاثة أسابيع، يتم خلالها تنفيذ المشروعات وتسليمها للجنة متخصصة للتحكيم وفق معايير تشمل جودة التصميم، وتجربة المستخدم، وسهولة الاستخدام، والأداء، ومدى قابلية التطبيق على الموقع الرسمي للجامعة.
وتتضمن المسابقة عددًا من الحوافز المميزة، حيث سيتم تنفيذ التصميم الفائز على الموقع الإلكتروني الرسمي للجامعة، إلى جانب منح شهادات معتمدة للمشاركين، وتقديم دورات تدريبية مجانية، بالإضافة إلى جوائز مادية للمراكز الأولى، في إطار دعم وتشجيع الطلاب على الابتكار والإبداع.
ودعت الجامعة جميع الطلاب المهتمين بمجالات التكنولوجيا والتصميم إلى المشاركة في هذه التجربة المتميزة، والتي تمثل فرصة حقيقية لتطبيق المعارف الأكاديمية في
مشروع عملي يخدم الجامعة بشكل مباشر، ويسهم في بناء خبرات قوية يمكن الاستفادة منها في سوق العمل.علما بأن أخر ميعاد للأشتراك وتسجل أسم الفرق 14 أبريل وأخر موعد لإستلام المشروع يوم 27 أبريل.
وللتسجيل في المسابقة، يُرجى ملء نموذج المشاركة من خلال الرابط التالي:
[
EPNU TechX 2026
سجل فى مسابقة
]
وتأتي هذه المبادرة في إطار استراتيجية الجامعة لتعزيز الابتكار الطلابي، وربط العملية التعليمية بالتطبيق العملي، بما يساهم في إعداد كوادر مؤهلة وقادرة على مواكبة متطلبات العصر الرقمي.
Views: 174
text_en:
As part of East Port Said National University's commitment to supporting digital transformation and strengthening students' applied skills, the university's Information Systems Center announced the launch of the annual technology competition EPNU TechX 2026, under the patronage of Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President.
The competition aims to engage university students in developing academic program pages on the official website by designing and implementing a unified template using the content management system WordPress, contributing to improving user experience, presenting academic content in a more organized and engaging manner, and supporting the university's direction toward digital transformation and technological modernization.
The competition provides university students with the opportunity to participate in teams of two to four students. Team members will collaborate to develop an integrated model for academic program pages, while adhering to approved official content and improving design, user experience, and ease of navigation, especially on mobile devices. The competition will run for three weeks, during which projects will be implemented and submitted to a specialized judging committee according to criteria including design quality, user experience, usability, performance, and applicability to the university's official website.
The competition includes several distinguished incentives. The winning design will be implemented on the university's official website, participants will receive accredited certificates, free training courses will be offered, and cash prizes will be awarded to the top places, in support of student innovation and creativity.
The university invited all students interested in technology and design to participate in this distinguished experience, which represents a genuine opportunity to apply academic knowledge in
a practical project that directly serves the university and helps build strong experience that can be applied in the labor market. The deadline for participation and team registration is April 14, and the final project submission deadline is April 27.
To register for the competition, please complete the participation form through the following link:
[ EPNU TechX 2026Register for the Competition ]
This initiative comes as part of the university's strategy to promote student innovation and connect the educational process with practical application, contributing to the preparation of qualified cadres capable of keeping pace with the requirements of the digital age.

title: Acceptance of research by students of East Port Said Private Medical School among the top 97 papers at the 9th Scientific Conference of Ain Shams Medical School
text:
As part of East Port Said National University's commitment to supporting scientific research and developing students' research capabilities, and under the patronage of Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President, and Dr. Sherine El-Khouly, Director of the Medicine and Surgery Program, and under the supervision of Dr. Nesreen Farouk, fourth-year Faculty of Medicine students achieved a distinguished scientific accomplishment through their participation in the activities of
the Ninth Scientific Conference at the Faculty of Medicine, Ain Shams University
, one of the most prominent medical conferences among faculties of medicine in Egypt.
The participation included the presentation of two distinguished scientific research papers, reflecting an advanced level of research competence and the ability to address contemporary medical issues with a direct impact on public health:
🔹
First research paper:
The Impact of an Educational Program regarding Antibiotics Resistance among first year medical students of East Portsaid National University: An Interventional Study
Prepared by:
Ahmed Ali Zamel, Toqa Essam Samir, and Moamen Thabet Abdelwahab
🔹
Second research paper:
Prevalence and Risk Factors of Autism Spectrum Disorder among Preschool Children in Port Said Governorate
Prepared by:
Sherif Mohamed Mohamed, Mohamed Emad Fahmy, Mahmoud Meftah, and Omar Ahmed Mohamed
Both research papers were accepted among
only 97 papers out of a total of 150 submissions
, an achievement that reflects the excellence of the faculty's students and their ability to compete in prestigious scientific forums.
The conference also witnessed the attendance and participation of several faculty students from different academic years, as part of efforts to strengthen awareness of the latest scientific developments, promote understanding of the importance of scientific research, and encourage active engagement in this vital field.
This participation confirms the commitment of the Faculty of Medicine at East Port Said National University to preparing a generation of physician-researchers capable of innovation and contribution to the development of the healthcare system, in line with the state's direction toward supporting scientific research and achieving sustainable development.

title: Between instilling values and creating hope.. The delegation from East Port Said National University joins 'Health Improvement' children on their annual day
text:
استرشاداً بالهدي النبوي الشريف في قوله ﷺ:
«أنا وكافل اليتيم في الجنة هكذا»
، وإيماناً بالمسؤولية الأخلاقية والمجتمعية التي تضطلع بها المؤسسات الأكاديمية، شاركت جامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية أطفال جمعية تحسين الصحة لرعاية الأيتام بالمحافظة احتفالاتهم بيوم اليتيم، وذلك تحت رعاية وبتوجيهات
المهندس إبراهيم محلب
، رئيس مجلس الأمناء، والأستاذ الدكتور
عاطف علم الدين
، رئيس الجامعة.
وقد حرص وفد الجامعة خلال اللقاء على تقديم رسالة تحفيزية لـ
أطفال الجمعية
، تهدف إلى إيقاد شعلة الطموح في نفوسهم، وحثهم على التفوق الدراسي باعتباره المسار الأمثل لبناء مستقبل واعد، مع التأكيد على أن أبواب الجامعة ترحب دائماً بالمتميزين والمكافحين، مما ساهم في تعزيز ثقتهم بذواتهم ورفع سقف تطلعاتهم ليكونوا يوماً ما ضمن صفوف طلاب الجامعة المبدعين.
وعلى الجانب الآخر، مثّلت هذه التجربة لـ
طلاب الجامعة
درساً عملياً في المسؤولية المدنية، حيث أتاحت لهم فرصة الاحتكاك المباشر مع قضايا المجتمع، مما ساهم في صقل شخصياتهم القيادية وتعزيز قيم العطاء لديهم، وتنمية مهارات التواصل الإنساني التي تُعد ركيزة أساسية في تكوين الكادر الجامعي المتكامل.
وأكدت إدارة الجامعة أن هذه المبادرة تأتي ضمن استراتيجية متكاملة لربط الطالب بواقعه المجتمعي، وتحويل القيم الأخلاقية إلى ممارسات ميدانية، تعكس عمق التعاون بين الجامعة ومؤسسات المجتمع المدني ببورسعيد، سعياً لتحقيق التنمية البشرية والاجتماعية الشاملة، والاستثمار في بناء الإنسان منذ الصغر.

استرشاداً بالهدي النبوي الشريف في قوله ﷺ: «أنا وكافل اليتيم في الجنة هكذا»، وإيماناً بالمسؤولية الأخلاقية والمجتمعية التي تضطلع بها المؤسسات الأكاديمية، شاركت جامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية أطفال جمعية تحسين الصحة لرعاية الأيتام بالمحافظة احتفالاتهم بيوم اليتيم، وذلك تحت رعاية وبتوجيهات المهندس إبراهيم محلب، رئيس مجلس الأمناء، والأستاذ الدكتور عاطف علم الدين، رئيس الجامعة.
وقد حرص وفد الجامعة خلال اللقاء على تقديم رسالة تحفيزية لـ أطفال الجمعية، تهدف إلى إيقاد شعلة الطموح في نفوسهم، وحثهم على التفوق الدراسي باعتباره المسار الأمثل لبناء مستقبل واعد، مع التأكيد على أن أبواب الجامعة ترحب دائماً بالمتميزين والمكافحين، مما ساهم في تعزيز ثقتهم بذواتهم ورفع سقف تطلعاتهم ليكونوا يوماً ما ضمن صفوف طلاب الجامعة المبدعين.
وعلى الجانب الآخر، مثّلت هذه التجربة لـ طلاب الجامعة درساً عملياً في المسؤولية المدنية، حيث أتاحت لهم فرصة الاحتكاك المباشر مع قضايا المجتمع، مما ساهم في صقل شخصياتهم القيادية وتعزيز قيم العطاء لديهم، وتنمية مهارات التواصل الإنساني التي تُعد ركيزة أساسية في تكوين الكادر الجامعي المتكامل.
وأكدت إدارة الجامعة أن هذه المبادرة تأتي ضمن استراتيجية متكاملة لربط الطالب بواقعه المجتمعي، وتحويل القيم الأخلاقية إلى ممارسات ميدانية، تعكس عمق التعاون بين الجامعة ومؤسسات المجتمع المدني ببورسعيد، سعياً لتحقيق التنمية البشرية والاجتماعية الشاملة، والاستثمار في بناء الإنسان منذ الصغر.

title: Applied Health Sciences students at East Port Said National University visit the plasma donation centre to enhance practical training
text:
تحت رعاية الأستاذ الدكتور/ عاطف علم الدين – رئيس جامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية، والدكتورة/ سلمى خيرالله – مدير برنامج العلوم الصحية التطبيقية، نظّمت كلية العلوم الصحية التطبيقية زيارة ميدانية لعدد من طلابها إلى أحد مراكز التبرع بالبلازما، في إطار دعم الجانب التطبيقي وتعزيز الوعي الصحي لدى الطلاب.
وهدفت الزيارة إلى تعريف الطلاب بآليات التبرع بالبلازما وأهميتها الحيوية في إنقاذ حياة المرضى، ودورها المحوري في دعم المنظومة الصحية من خلال توفير مشتقات البلازما المستخدمة في العديد من العلاجات الطبية المتقدمة.
وخلال الزيارة، اطّلع الطلاب على مختلف مراحل سحب البلازما، والإجراءات الفنية والطبية المتبعة، إلى جانب التعرف على معايير الجودة وإجراءات السلامة المعتمدة داخل مراكز التبرع، بما يضمن الحفاظ على صحة المتبرعين وسلامة المنتجات الطبية.
وتأتي هذه الزيارة في إطار استراتيجية الكلية الهادفة إلى ربط الجانب الأكاديمي بالتطبيق العملي، وتنمية المهارات المهنية لدى الطلاب، بما يسهم في إعداد كوادر مؤهلة قادرة على تلبية احتياجات سوق العمل في القطاع الصحي.
💬 وفي ختام الزيارة،
أعربت إدارة الكلية عن تمنياتها لطلابها بدوام التوفيق والنجاح، مؤكدة استمرار دعمها لكافة الأنشطة العلمية والتدريبية التي تسهم في بناء خبرات الطلاب وتعزيز جاهزيتهم المهنية.

title: East Port Said Private University approves binding procedures to rationalize energy consumption and enhance usage efficiency
text:
As part of its full commitment to implementing the directives of the Egyptian state and the decisions of the Council of Ministers regarding rationalizing energy consumption and maximizing resource efficiency, Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, President of East Port Said National University, issued a comprehensive administrative decision to apply a package of mandatory executive measures to rationalize electricity consumption and improve energy efficiency across all university sectors.
The decision covers all educational and service facilities, classrooms, laboratories, and administrative facilities, reflecting the university's direction toward adopting sustainable operational practices aligned with the National Energy Strategy and Egypt Vision 2030.
The University President affirmed that this decision comes in direct response to current global economic challenges and in light of the state's direction toward rationalizing expenditure and maximizing the use of resources. He noted that the university is working to achieve a balanced equation between academic and administrative performance efficiency and the rational use of energy resources, without affecting the quality of the educational process.
He explained that the decision includes several regulatory controls and procedures, most notably:
Full commitment to rationalizing electricity consumption across all university buildings and facilities.
Switching off unnecessary lighting immediately after official working hours, while observing security and safety requirements.
Reducing electrical loads during evening periods while maintaining the operation of vital facilities.
Expanding reliance on natural lighting inside classrooms and laboratories.
Improving the operating efficiency of electrical devices and regulating usage patterns within the various units.
In this context, the University President directed the Secretary-General of the University, the directors of the various departments, and the Engineering Department to prepare and implement an integrated operational plan that includes clear mechanisms for follow-up, periodic monitoring, measuring energy consumption rates, and preparing regular reports to track achieved rationalization rates and evaluate performance.
Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din stressed that compliance with these measures is a national duty and a collective responsibility requiring the combined efforts of all university members. He affirmed that embedding a culture of rational energy consumption is one of the key pillars for achieving sustainable development, supporting the national economy, and ensuring resource sustainability for future generations.

title: Midterm Examinations for the Second Semester of the 2025/2026 Academic Year Begin at East Port Said National University
text:
As part of East Port Said National University's commitment to the regularity of the educational process and the enhancement of academic performance quality, midterm examinations for the second semester began on Sunday, March 29, 2026, across the various academic programs.
The examinations were held in five academic programs. Examination committees witnessed notable student attendance and a disciplined, well-organized atmosphere, with all necessary means of comfort and support provided to ensure that examinations are conducted in an appropriate educational environment.
The examinations are held under the patronage of Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President, who emphasized the importance of adhering to the regulations governing examination procedures and of creating the appropriate atmosphere to ensure equal opportunities among students.
He also directed the relevant departments to continuously follow up on examination procedures to ensure the regularity of committees and the immediate handling of any obstacles that may arise, thereby ensuring the efficient and orderly conduct of the examination process.
For their part, the various program administrations were keen to apply all organizational procedures, adhere to approved timetables, and provide qualified academic and administrative staff to supervise the examination committees.

title: At Its 14th Meeting: The Academic Affairs Council at East Port Said National University Discusses Program Development and Enhancing Education Quality
text:
في إطار المتابعة المستمرة لمنظومة العمل الأكاديمي وتعزيز جودة العملية التعليمية، انعقد يوم الثلاثاء الموافق 24 مارس 2026 اجتماع مجلس الشئون الأكاديمية بجامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية في جلسته رقم (14)، برئاسة الأستاذ الدكتور/ عاطف علم الدين – رئيس الجامعة، وبحضور السادة مديري البرامج، ومدير إدارة شئون الطلاب المركزية، ومدير مكتب القبول والتسجيل.
ويأتي هذا الاجتماع تأكيدًا على التزام الجامعة بتطبيق أعلى معايير الجودة الأكاديمية والإدارية، حيث تم استعراض مستجدات سير الدراسة، ومناقشة آليات تطويرها بما يتماشى مع المتغيرات المحلية والدولية ومتطلبات سوق العمل.
وأكد رئيس الجامعة على ضرورة انتظام العملية التعليمية عقب انتهاء إجازة شهر رمضان المبارك وعيد الفطر، بما يضمن استيفاء المقررات الدراسية وفق الجداول الزمنية المعتمدة، وتحقيق مخرجات تعليمية متميزة.
🎓 أبرز الموضوعات التي ناقشها المجلس:
▪️ استعراض توجيهات الأستاذ الدكتور/ عبد العزيز قنصوه – وزير التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي، بشأن تطوير منظومة الجامعات الأهلية، والتي ترتكز على:
✔️ الارتقاء بجودة التعليم والتعلم
✔️ تحديث البرامج الأكاديمية وفق متطلبات سوق العمل
✔️ تعزيز التعاون الدولي والشراكات الأكاديمية
✔️ تنمية مهارات المستقبل لدى الطلاب
✔️ تسريع التحول الرقمي في العملية التعليمية
✔️ دعم التكامل مع قطاع الصناعة
✔️ تحفيز الابتكار وريادة الأعمال
✔️ تعزيز البحث العلمي التطبيقي المرتبط بالتنمية المستدامة ورؤية مصر 2030
▪️ اعتماد الجدول الزمني لامتحانات منتصف الفصل الدراسي الثاني، مع مراعاة الأعياد الرسمية (عيد القيامة – شم النسيم).
▪️ اعتماد نتائج التظلمات والالتماسات الطلابية في إطار من الشفافية وتكافؤ الفرص.
▪️ الموافقة على طلبات تأجيل الامتحانات وفقًا للضوابط المنظمة.
▪️ إقرار عدد من حالات تخفيض المصروفات دعمًا للطلاب غير القادرين وتخفيفًا للأعباء الاقتصادية.
▪️ مناقشة تطوير اللوائح والبرامج الدراسية بما يواكب التطورات التكنولوجية والاقتصادية.
▪️ بحث آليات تفعيل نظم التعليم عن بُعد عند الضرورة، بما يضمن استمرارية العملية التعليمية في ظل التحديات العالمية الراهنة، خاصة ما يتعلق بتداعيات الأوضاع الاقتصادية وتأثيراتها على قطاع الطاقة.
💬 وفي ختام الاجتماع،
شدد رئيس الجامعة على حرص إدارة الجامعة على ترسيخ بيئة تعليمية مستقرة ومنضبطة، داعيًا الطلاب إلى الالتزام الكامل باللوائح والتعليمات الأكاديمية، وبذل أقصى الجهد لتحقيق التميز، مؤكدًا استمرار دعم الجامعة لأبنائها على المستويين الأكاديمي والإدارى

title: Former Prime Minister Eng. Ibrahim Mahlab and Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din Congratulate the University Community and the Islamic Nation on Eid Al-Fitr
text:
With sentiments filled with affection and pride,
the University Board of Trustees, chaired by Eng. Ibrahim Mahlab, former Prime Minister and Chairman of the Board of Trustees, and Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President and former member of the Senate,
extend their highest congratulations and best wishes to all members of the university community, including faculty members, teaching assistants, administrative staff, and our students, on the occasion of Eid Al-Fitr.
As the University Presidency and its Board of Trustees mark this blessed occasion, they express their sincere appreciation for the efforts of all dedicated university personnel in advancing the path of knowledge and development. They also extend heartfelt congratulations to the entire Islamic nation, praying that Almighty God accept our good deeds and yours, return these blessed days to our dear homeland and the whole world with goodness, prosperity, and blessings, and preserve security, stability, and prosperity for our beloved Egypt under its wise leadership. Eid Mubarak.

title: Faculty of Medicine Students Participate in the Sixth Annual Mansoura Manchester Conference
text:
Under the patronage of Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, President of East Port Said National University,
and Dr. Sherine El-Khouly, Director of the university's Medicine and Surgery Program,
and under the supervision of Dr. Nesreen Farouk, Lecturer of Public Health and Community Medicine,
and Dr. Nehal Gamal Sharaf El-Din, Teaching Assistant of Public Health and Community Medicine,
fourth-year Faculty of Medicine students at East Port Said National University participated in the Sixth Annual Mansoura Manchester Student Research Conference with a scientific paper entitled:
"Prevalence and Risk Factors of Autism Spectrum Disorder among Preschool Children in Port Said Governorate"
(Prevalence and Risk Factors of Autism Spectrum Disorder among Preschool Children in Port Said Governorate)
This participation comes as part of the university's efforts to strengthen the applied research role of its students in addressing important health issues in society.
The university is proud of its participating students, who presented an honorable model of serious scientific research, teamwork, and academic commitment. It wishes them continued success and affirms its ongoing support for all efforts that contribute to developing students' research and innovation skills.

title: East Port Said National University Board of Trustees Discusses Educational Development and Approves New Decisions at Its Tenth Meeting
text:
The Board of Trustees of East Port Said National University held its tenth meeting today, Tuesday, March 17, 2026, at Port Said University, chaired by Eng. Ibrahim Mahlab, Chairman of the Board of Trustees, with the participation of Prof. Dr. Mohamed Hassan El-Kenawy, Vice Chairman of the Board; Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din; Prof. Dr. Sherif Saleh; and the attendance of the board members.
The session opened with Eng. Ibrahim Mahlab welcoming the attendees. He thanked Major General Staff Mohab Habashi in appreciation of his efforts and congratulated Major General Ibrahim Abu Limoun on joining the Board of Trustees. He also congratulated the university community, including faculty members, staff, and students, on the occasion of Eid Al-Fitr.
The session discussed several vital files that reflect the university's direction toward providing a modern and advanced educational model based on quality and innovation, in line with labor market requirements. The board reviewed a range of academic, financial, and administrative topics as part of the continuous effort to develop the educational system and enhance institutional performance efficiency.
The main discussion areas included supporting university students through mechanisms that facilitate the educational process and provide a stimulating environment, in addition to supporting and developing academic cadres in a way that raises the scientific and research level. The board also discussed approving several new appointments and assignments, reviewed financial and organizational files that support the educational process, and established rules and controls governing student scholarships.
At the conclusion of the session, Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din affirmed that East Port Said National University is moving steadily toward consolidating its position as a leading educational institution. He stressed that supporting students and upgrading academic competencies are among its top priorities, contributing to preparing qualified cadres capable of competing locally and regionally and achieving the Egyptian state's vision of building an aware person qualified for the requirements of the future.

title: The University President Attends the Conclusion of the Ramadan Tournament for the Year 1447 AH
text:
nder the patronage of Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, President of the University,
أقامت الجامعة الحفل الختامي للدورة الرمضانية لكليات الجامعة، والذي شهد تكريم الطلاب الفائزين وتوزيع الجوائز عليهم، وذلك تقديرًا لتميزهم خلال المنافسات الرياضية والثقافية التي أُقيمت بين طلاب الكليات المختلفة طوال شهر رمضان المبارك.
وجاء الحفل تتويجًا لسلسلة من الفعاليات والأنشطة التي اتسمت بروح التنافس الشريف والحماس بين الطلاب، حيث شارك عدد كبير من أبناء الجامعة في مسابقات تنس الطاولة، ودوري خماسي كرة القدم، ومسابقة الشطرنج، في أجواء مليئة بروح الأخوة والتعاون والانتماء.
وخلال الحفل، تم تكريم الطلاب والفرق الفائزة بالمراكز الأولى، وسط أجواء من الفرحة والفخر بما قدمه الطلاب من أداء متميز وروح رياضية عالية، عكست وعي طلاب الجامعة وحرصهم على المشاركة الفاعلة في الأنشطة الطلابية.
وفي كلمته لأبنائه الطلاب، أكد الأستاذ الدكتور/ عاطف علم الدين – رئيس الجامعة أن الأنشطة الطلابية تمثل أحد الركائز الأساسية في بناء شخصية الطالب المتكاملة، مشيرًا إلى أن الجامعة لا تهدف فقط إلى التفوق الأكاديمي، بل تسعى أيضًا إلى تنمية مهارات الطلاب وتعزيز روح العمل الجماعي والانتماء لديهم.
كما أعرب سيادته عن سعادته بالمستوى المتميز الذي ظهر به الطلاب خلال فعاليات الدورة الرمضانية، موجهًا التهنئة للفائزين، ومشيدًا بروح المنافسة الراقية التي تحلّى بها جميع المشاركين.
وفي ختام الحفل، أُقيمت ندوة دينية تناولت فضل شهر رمضان المبارك، وكيفية اغتنام أيامه المباركة والفوز بليلة القدر، وذلك في إطار حرص الجامعة على تعزيز الوعي الديني والقيم الروحية لدى أبنائها الطلاب.
وقد حاضر في الندوة كلٌ من
فضيلة الشيخ الدكتور/ رفعت برهام – من منطقة وعظ بورسعيد،
وفضيلة الشيخ/ أشرف عبد المنعم – إمام وخطيب مسجد بورفؤاد الكبير،
حيث قدّما كلمات توعوية تناولت مكانة شهر رمضان وفضل ليلة القدر، وأهمية استثمار هذه الأيام المباركة في الطاعات والعمل الصالح.
واختُتمت الفعاليات في أجواء روحانية مميزة، عكست روح الشهر الكريم، وسط إشادة من الحضور بما تقدمه الجامعة من أنشطة تجمع بين التميز العلمي وبناء الوعي الثقافي والديني لدى طلابها.

title: East Port Said National University Monitors First-Semester Examinations in Medicine and Pharmacy
text:
East Port Said National University continues to monitor first-semester examinations for students in the Clinical Pharmacy and Medicine and Surgery programs, with calm, disciplined conditions and organizational measures ensuring the smooth operation of examination halls.
The examinations are being held under the patronage of Professor Atef Alam El-Din, University President, and the supervision of Associate Professor Mohamed Yasser, Director of the Clinical Pharmacy Program, and Dr. Sherine El-Kholy, Director of the Medicine and Surgery Program.
During his tour of the examination halls, the University President emphasized the university’s commitment to providing a safe and well-organized examination environment that serves students’ interests and ensures full compliance with regulations. He noted that the orderly conduct of examinations reflects the university’s readiness and coordination.
Monitoring Medicine and Pharmacy Examination Halls
Associate Professor Mohamed Yasser monitored the Clinical Pharmacy examination halls and verified compliance with the approved instructions, while Dr. Sherine El-Kholy followed up on the Medicine and Surgery examinations and ensured that students were provided with suitable conditions.
The examinations reflected effective cooperation among faculty members, teaching assistants, and administrative staff, demonstrating the spirit of teamwork across the university. East Port Said National University wishes all its students continued success and excellence.

title: East Port Said National University Warns Against Unofficial Admission and Transfer Channels
text:
East Port Said National University confirmed that all approved information regarding admission and transfer procedures is issued exclusively through the university’s premises and official channels.
The university clarified that announcements or information circulated by external parties do not represent it and should not be considered official. It stressed the importance of relying on official sources when inquiring about admission, application, and transfer procedures.
The university also urged students and parents to verify information carefully and communicate directly with the relevant university departments to obtain accurate guidance and avoid unreliable information or practices that could harm applicants’ interests.
Official Channels
Official matters concerning applications and transfers are handled only through East Port Said National University’s premises or the university’s announced official digital channels.

title: Academic Vacancies Announcement
text:
As part of East Port Said National University's efforts to build a rich and diverse database of distinguished academic cadres capable of contributing to the university's development, addressing staffing needs in some faculties, and supporting the educational process, examinations, and university activities, the university announces the opening of applications for faculty member and teaching assistant positions through annual contracts, full-time or part-time secondment, or appointment, in accordance with the conditions, controls, and standards stipulated in the relevant laws, regulations, and the rules governing this announcement.
For further details, please visit the following link:
https://forms.gle/18fChJi2oEEZ4bzWA
General Application Criteria:
The applicant must be an Egyptian national.
The applicant must have obtained at least a Very Good grade in the first university degree.
The applicant must have obtained at least a Good grade in the specialization.
Proficiency in spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate effectively in academic contexts.
Proficiency in using general and specialized computer applications.
Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
General Application Criteria:
Adequate academic experience in university teaching and curriculum development.
Participation in distinguished research and scientific projects at the local and international levels.
Publication of scientific research in specialized peer-reviewed international journals.
Experience in using electronic grading technologies and modern assessment and evaluation systems.
Contribution to university and community service activities.
Experience in academic advising for students.
Familiarity with academic quality assurance and planning work.
Required Application Documents:
Complete the application form using the link attached to the announcement.
A copy of certified academic certificates.
A copy of the national ID card.
An updated CV including academic and research experience.
Any additional documents supporting the application, such as training certificates, etc.
Application Method:
Applications will be received through
https://forms.gle/18fChJi2oEEZ4bzWA
all required documents must be uploaded from December 23, 2024, to January 3, 2025.
Evaluation Stages:
First Stage:
Review of submitted documents by a committee formed by the University President.
.
Second Stage:
Inviting shortlisted candidates for a personal interview and presentation.
Disclaimer:
Any misrepresentation or omission of facts relevant to the recruitment process in the application form, CV, or personal interview may result in termination of the recruitment process or contract, in addition to other legal measures.

title: “Spark of Innovation: Tea, Coffee, and Technology”
text:
Under the patronage of Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President, and Prof. Dr. Rasha Anany, Vice President for Academic Affairs,
the Mechatronics and Automation Engineering Program organized
a distinguished student event entitled:
“Spark of Innovation: Tea, Coffee, and Technology”
In an atmosphere full of enthusiasm and creativity, students and faculty members gathered to discuss a range of innovative ideas and projects in mechatronics and industrial applications of automated systems.
During the event, Prof. Dr. Rasha Anany discussed the students' work as they presented their distinguished practical projects, which included:
A robot that follows lines drawn on the ground.
Car-shaped robots controlled remotely via Bluetooth.
Miniature models of industrial robots: one with four axes and another with six axes.
This event was not merely a project exhibition; it was an opportunity for exchanging ideas and fostering collaboration between students and faculty members, strengthening the spirit of innovation in an inspiring educational environment.

title: A Journey into the Depths of Egypt's Cultures
text:
As part of a journey into the depth of Egypt's cultures, and in the presence of Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President; Prof. Dr. Rasha Anany, Vice President for Academic Affairs; and Mr. Moheb Fathy Heiba, Secretary-General of the University, and under the supervision of the University Student Union, represented by student Essam Gomaa, Union President, student Ahmed Zamel, Vice President of the Union, and the Student Welfare Department led by Mr. Ehab Abu El-Maati,
the university held Egyptian Cultures Day, which aims to introduce students to the customs, traditions, dialects, and distinctive foods of all governorates of Egypt. Students enjoyed presentations on historical figures and archaeological sites in each governorate, accompanied by detailed explanations from representatives of each region. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din praised the organization, addressed the students, and encouraged them to prepare for their midyear examinations, affirming that the university will make every effort to provide a healthy environment for them and wishing them continued success.

title: The Prime Minister Arrives in Port Said Governorate to Begin an Inspection Tour of Several Industrial, Development, and Service Projects
text:
Dr. Mostafa Madbouly, Prime Minister, made several important statements today at the conclusion of his visit to Port Said Governorate.
He was accompanied by
Lieutenant General Eng. Kamel El-Wazir, Deputy Prime Minister for Industrial Development and Minister of Industry and Transport,
Dr. Manal Awad, Minister of Local Development,
Eng. Sherif El-Sherbiny, Minister of Housing, Utilities, and Urban Communities,
Mr. Mohamed Abdel Latif, Minister of Education and Technical Education,
Major General Moheb Habashi, Governor of Port Said,
Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, former member of the Senate and University President,
Among the most important statements was his reference to the importance of developing the roads connecting to East Port Said, particularly near Salam City, known as the ferry road.
He stated that work would begin immediately on implementing this road, given its role in shortening the travel time to East Port Said to no more than half an hour. He affirmed that implementing this road will help attract further development activity to the East Port Said area.
He also approved the allocation of land for establishing university housing to serve our students.
May God protect Egypt, its government, people, and army.

title: Proceedings of the Ninth Scientific Conference of the Damietta Pharmacists Syndicate
text:
شارك الأستاذ الدكتور/ عاطف علم الدين .. رئيس الجامعة
والأستاذ الدكتور/ رشا عناني .. نائب رئيس الجامعة للشئون الأكاديمية
والأستاذ مساعد دكتور/ محمد ياسر .. مدير برنامج الصيدلة الإكلينيكية
Pharmacy.EPU
والأستاذ الدكتور/ أمجد منصور .. وكيل كليه الصيدلة جامعة بورسعيد استاذ العقاقير الطبيه بجامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية
في إطلاق فعاليات المؤتمر العلمى التاسع لنقابة صيادلة دمياط
المؤتمر الصيدلي الاقدم والنسخه السادسه من مؤتمر الصيادلة المصريين فى فندق شتايجنبرجر برأس البر
وذلك تحت رعاية السيد/ أيمن الشهابي محافظ دمياط
وبدعوه كريمه من الدكتور/ خالد النجدي .. نقيب صيادله دمياط
والدكتور/ وائل علي .. رئيس المؤسسة المصرية للصيدلة وعضو الاتحاد الدولى للصيدلة.
وبحضور قيادات علمية وقامت أكاديمية بارزة من مختلف جامعات مصر
دار المؤتمر حول تسليط الضوء علي مهنة الصيدلة بمنظورها العصري والذي حاضر به كوكبة من شباب علماء مصر الذين تبوأوا مراكز تنفيذية وقيادية فى مختلف مجالات القطاع الصحي
كما حضر المؤتمر لفيف من نقباء الصيدله بالنقابات الفرعية
هذا وقد أثني الحضور علي محاضره الأستاذ الدكتور محمد ياسر
Mohamed Yasser Hamdy
مدير برنامج الصيدله الاكلينيكيه والتي سلطت الضوء علي تطبيق مبادئ ريادة الأعمال في مجال التركيبات الصيدلية والتجميلية
تحت عنوان from Formula to Fortune
تأتي هذه المشاركه في ضوء خطة الجامعة في المشاركة المجتمعية الفعالة إيماناً بهذا الدور الريادي وتحقيقاً لإستراتيجيات جامعات الجيل الرابع
Views: 35
text_en:
Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President, participated,
together with Prof. Dr. Rasha Anany, Vice President for Academic Affairs,
Assoc. Prof. Dr. Mohamed Yasser, Director of the Clinical Pharmacy Program, Pharmacy.EPU
and Prof. Dr. Amjad Mansour, Vice Dean of the Faculty of Pharmacy at Port Said University and Professor of Pharmacognosy at East Port Said National University,
in launching the activities of the Ninth Scientific Conference of the Damietta Pharmacists Syndicate.
The conference is the oldest pharmaceutical conference and the sixth edition of the Egyptian Pharmacists Conference, held at the Steigenberger Hotel in Ras El Bar.
It was held under the patronage of Mr. Ayman El-Shahaby, Governor of Damietta,
and at the kind invitation of Dr. Khaled El-Nagdy, Head of the Damietta Pharmacists Syndicate,
and Dr. Wael Ali, President of the Egyptian Pharmaceutical Foundation and member of the International Pharmaceutical Federation.
The conference was attended by prominent scientific leaders and academic figures from various Egyptian universities.
The conference focused on highlighting the pharmacy profession from a contemporary perspective, with lectures delivered by a distinguished group of young Egyptian scientists who hold executive and leadership positions across various areas of the healthcare sector.
The conference was also attended by a number of heads of pharmacy syndicates from branch syndicates.
Attendees praised the lecture delivered by Prof. Dr. Mohamed Yasser, Mohamed Yasser Hamdy Director of the Clinical Pharmacy Program, which highlighted the application of entrepreneurship principles in pharmaceutical and cosmetic formulations,
under the title "From Formula to Fortune".
This participation comes in light of the university's plan for active community engagement, in recognition of this leading role and in pursuit of the strategies of fourth-generation universities.

title: Graduation Ceremony of the First Cohort of Zohr School of Applied Technology in Port Said
text:
شهد الأستاذ الدكتور / عاطف علم الدين رئيس الجامعة حفل تخرج الدفعة الأولى من مدرسة ظهر للتكنولوجيا التطبيقية ببورسعيد
بحضور اللواء محب حبشى محافظ بورسعيد ووزير التربية والتعليم الاستاذ محمد عبد اللطيف ووزير البترول المهندس كريم بدوى والسفير الايطالي ومؤسسة السويدي ، وأعضاء البرلمان
الجدير بالذكر أن
مدرسة ظهر للتكنولوجيا التطبيقية
انطلقت عام 2021، تحت رعاية وزارة التربية والتعليم والتعليم الفنى، ووزارة البترول والثروة المعدنية، ومحافظة بورسعيد .
وبالاشتراك مع مؤسسة ايوك ، وشركة الغاز الطبيعي المصرية القابضة ، وشركة بترول بلاعيم ومؤسسة السويدي اليكتريك
وذلك بهدف تعزيز مهارات الشباب التقنية لتحسين فرص العمل في محافظة بورسعيد
من خلال تعليم وتدريب تقنيين مهنيين ممتازين، إلى جانب تلبية احتياجات الصناعة من العمالة المؤهلة التي ترتبط ارتباطاً مباشراً بالنمو الاقتصادي في
#مصر
.
وتضم مدرسة حقل ظهر التكنولوجية الفنية المتقدمة 5 أقسام، تتضمن تخصصات
صيانة وتشغيل معدات الطاقة، والصيانة الكهربائية، والشبكات وأمن المعلومات، واللوجستيات، وصيانة السيارات والمركبات الخفيفة
Views: 50
text_en:
Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President, attended the graduation ceremony of the first cohort of Zohr School of Applied Technology in Port Said.
The ceremony was attended by Major General Moheb Habashi, Governor of Port Said; Minister of Education Mohamed Abdel Latif; Minister of Petroleum Eng. Karim Badawi; the Italian Ambassador; Elsewedy Foundation; and members of parliament.
It is worth noting that Zohr School of Applied Technology
was launched in 2021 under the patronage of the Ministry of Education and Technical Education, the Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources, and Port Said Governorate.
It was established in partnership with Eni, the Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company, Petrobel, and Elsewedy Electric Foundation.
The school aims to enhance young people's technical skills and improve employment opportunities in Port Said Governorate
by educating and training outstanding professional technicians, while also meeting industry needs for qualified labor directly linked to economic growth in #Egypt .
Zohr Advanced Technical School includes five departments, covering the specializations of
energy equipment maintenance and operation, electrical maintenance, networks and information security, logistics, and automobile and light vehicle maintenance.

title: Intensive Efforts to Establish University Housing at East Port Said National University
text:
As part of East Port Said National University's efforts to achieve integration across all aspects of university life and ensure stability for its students,

title: A Panorama of University Students' Scientific Contributions in Conferences, Events, and Educational, Research, and Community Initiatives
text:
Under the patronage of Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President,
and Prof. Dr. Rasha Anany, Vice President for Academic Affairs,
we present a panorama of university students' scientific contributions in conferences, events, and educational, research, and community initiatives
October - November 2024
through which the university advances its most important objective, derived from the National Strategy for Higher Education and Scientific Research: building competitive competencies within the national economy.
The university participated in the Second Scientific Conference on Health and Population in the New Administrative Capital, held under the theme Human Development for a Sustainable Future.
The conference provided our students with comprehensive understanding through numerous activities, interactive sessions, discussions, and workshops on diverse topics in health, population, and human development, delivered by local and international leaders, policymakers, entrepreneurs, researchers, and healthcare experts.
Under the supervision of:
Assoc. Prof. Dr. Mohamed Yasser, Director of the Pharmacy Program,
Dr. Sherine El-Khouly, Director of the Medicine and Surgery Program,
Prof. Dr. Rasha Emad, Director of the Applied Health Sciences Technology Program,
and teaching assistants from the Faculty of Pharmacy:
Teaching Assistant: Esraa El-Sayed Ahmed
Teaching Assistant: Eman Nasser Mohamed
Teaching Assistant: Rawda Mofeed Gamal
Teaching Assistant: Kholoud Mohamed El-Khader
The university also participated in the Scientific Week for Entrepreneurship held at Suez Canal University, aimed at promoting innovation and supporting entrepreneurship as part of Egypt Vision 2030 for sustainable development.
During the event, winning students in entrepreneurship competitions such as the Startup Olympics and the Egyptian Entrepreneurship League were honored, further motivating us to develop our ideas and transform them into practical projects.
Under the supervision of:
Assoc. Prof. Dr. Mohamed Yasser, Director of the Pharmacy Program,
Dr. Sherine El-Khouly, Director of the Medicine and Surgery Program,
Dr. Mohamed Mahrous, Lecturer at the Faculty of Pharmacy,
The university concluded its participation by attending the opening events of the Tamkeen Initiative in cooperation with the Global Hope Givers Campaign at Suez Canal University.
Under the supervision of:
Dr. Mohamed Metwally El-Sakka, Faculty of Engineering,
Mr. Ehab Abu El-Maati, Director of the Student Welfare Department,
and his supporting team:
Mr. Mohamed Gharib
Ms. Salma Shams

title: Third Water Day 2024
text:
Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President, participated in
the Third Water Day 2024 conference, organized by Port Said University in cooperation with Badr University,
under the theme: "University-Industry Integration for Innovation in Water Technology".
The event was held under the patronage of Prof. Dr. Sherif Saleh, President of Port Said University, and Prof. Dr. Ashraf El-Shihy, former Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research and President of Badr University.
The conference was chaired by Prof. Dr. Rawia Rizk, Vice President of Port Said University for Graduate Studies and Research,
with Dr. Eng. Kamal El-Nahhas, Head of the Works Department in Port Said, Suez Canal Authority, serving as conference secretary.
The event was attended by university vice presidents, faculty deans, professors, researchers, and students from the faculties of engineering and science.
The conference emphasized the importance of university-industry integration.
It brought together several water technology companies, which pledged to train students from the faculties of engineering and science in departments concerned with water desalination, water resources, and green hydrogen.

title: Our First Steps toward Launching Entrepreneurship and Innovation Activities at East Port Said National University
text:
Based on our university's belief in its students' capabilities and the importance of supporting their ambitions, and in line with the university's vision to prepare a generation of leaders and innovators who will contribute to building Egypt's future,
we are pleased
to announce our first steps toward launching entrepreneurship and innovation activities at East Port Said National University.
EPU Innovators
Under the generous patronage of Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President,
and with the support of Prof. Dr. Rasha Anany, Vice President for Academic Affairs,
and under the supervision of Assoc. Prof. Dr. Mohamed Yasser, the university's Entrepreneurship and Innovation Coordinator,
EPU Innovators
this platform brings together knowledge and ambition and gives university students the opportunity to develop their entrepreneurship skills through a practical and inspiring experience.
EPU Innovators
It is a forum for ideas and ambitions, aimed at transforming your ideas into successful projects that add real value to you and to our community. It will also serve as an umbrella bringing together all student families and entities, providing an ideal space for generating ideas and innovation, and offering workshops, training courses, and opportunities to connect with entrepreneurship experts to support you and expand your professional horizons.
If you aspire to join this distinctive journey, you can register through the following link:
https://docs.google.com/…/1FAIpQLScGmePcPXy…/viewform…
We look forward to your ideas and creativity so that together we can shape the future of entrepreneurship at our university.

title: Board of Trustees Meeting at the University Campus in East Port Said
text:
On the sidelines of the day organized by our university to commemorate the October Victories, under the patronage of the University President, Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, the first Board of Trustees meeting was held at the university campus in East Port Said.
The meeting was chaired by Eng. Ibrahim Mahlab, former Prime Minister of Egypt and Chairman of the Board of Trustees,
with the membership of:
- Prof. Dr. Mohamed Hassan El-Kenawy, former President of Mansoura University and Vice Chairman of the Board of Trustees,
- Major General Staff Moheb Habashi, Governor of Port Said,
- Major General Staff Ahmed Abdullah, former Governor of Port Said,
- Prof. Dr. Sherif Saleh, President of Port Said University,
- Prof. Dr. El-Sayed Hussein Hegazy, Emeritus Professor at the Faculty of Engineering, Port Said University,
- Prof. Dr. Nabil Ahmed Helmy, former Dean of the Faculty of Law, Zagazig University,
- Prof. Dr. Mamdouh Radwan El-Nahhas, Emeritus Professor at the Faculty of Medicine, Port Said University,
- Dr. Eng. Lotfy Hassan El-Badrawy, Board Member of Kapci Coatings,
- Dr. Hassan Hassanein Hassan, Vice Chairman and Managing Director of International Drug Agency for Pharmaceutical Industries,
- Mr. Mohamed El-Sayed Ali, Chairman of the Egyptian Chamber of Commerce in Port Said,
and in the presence of Prof. Dr. Rasha Anany, General Supervisor of the Education and Student Affairs Sector. During its session, the board discussed the university's internal regulations, as one of the fourth-generation universities concerned with excellence in education and scientific research. Several important matters related to the educational process at the university were also discussed, most notably accelerating the establishment of a university residence complex to serve its students.

title: Commemoration of the Glorious October Victories in the Presence of Distinguished National Figures and Leaders
text:
From the heart of beloved Sinai,
our university, headed by Prof. Dr. Atef Alam El-Din, University President, commemorated the glorious October Victories in the presence of a distinguished group of national figures and leaders, foremost among them
Eng. Ibrahim Mahlab, former Prime Minister of Egypt and Chairman of the Board of Trustees, and Major General Staff Moheb Habashi, Governor of Port Said,
Major General Staff Ahmed Abdullah, former Governor of Port Said; Prof. Dr. Sherif Saleh, President of Port Said University; strategic expert and political analyst Major General Samir Farag; and Major General Assem Saadoun, representing North Sinai Governorate,
as well as Prof. Dr. Medhat El-Hadek, President of Salam Technological University; members of the Senate representing North Sinai; representatives of North Sinai tribes; and a distinguished group of university professors and public figures.
On this day, the first meeting of the Board of Trustees was held inside the East Port Said National University campus, chaired by Eng. Ibrahim Mahlab and attended by the board members.
An educational seminar on the Sixth of October was also delivered by Major General Samir Farag, strategic expert and political analyst.
He explained the great role played by our heroic soldiers, including their sacrifices and acts of bravery, which enabled Egypt to reach its current standing.
May God protect Egypt, its army and its people.
